The name “Slovak Republic” has been used for two different states in the 20th century:

| State | Date of proclamation / establishment | Historical context |
|-------|----------------------------------------|--------------------|
| **First Slovak Republic** (often called the “Slovak State”) | **14 March 1939** | Declared independence from Czechoslovakia after the German occupation of the Czech lands. It existed as a client state of Nazi Germany until the end of World II in 1945. |
| **Current Slovak Republic** (the independent nation we know today) | **1 January 1993** | Formed when Czechoslovakia peacefully split into the Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic – an event known as the “Velvet Divorce.” |

So, depending on which period you’re referring to, the Slovak Republic was founded either on **14 March 1939** (the wartime state) or on **1 January 1993** (the modern independent republic).
